title: Client Manager
description:

This role drives effective requirement fulfillment and ensures a high-quality candidate and consultant experience aligned with client expectations. By leveraging data, maintaining program compliance, and partnering cross-functionally, the Client Manager strengthens client relationships, improves operational performance, and identifies opportunities for growth.
Work Location: This role can be remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Central Time Zone.
Core Job Responsibilities:

• Lead intake, qualification, and distribution of new requisitions (with Category Leader).

• Manage requisition statuses, priorities, and ensure client alignment.

• Submit candidates to client and coordinate candidate review/feedback.

• Oversee interview coordination with the client.

• Conduct interview preparation sessions and debriefs with candidates.

• Manage offer process with the Recruiter and/or the Category Leader.

• Track and report on pipeline health, submittal activity, and time-to-fill metrics.
